results.title: My Mother is a Witch
results.overview: When she receives news that her estranged mother has died, a Nigerian woman must return home from the UK and confront the pain of her past.

results.title: Jiaoying Summers: What Specie Are You?
results.original_title: Jiaoying Summers: What Specie Are You?
results.overview: It's the first comedy special from comedian and actress Jiaoying Summers, and sees her dissect what makes us different and what brings us together. Drawing from her life as a Chinese American and first-generation immigrant, she tackles topics like cultural clashes, immigrant identity and motherhood, among others.

results.title: 災厄曲: Saiyaku Kyoku
results.overview: Kaze, a mysterious outsider, and Zyan, his irreverent guide, search for a stolen dragon through a paranormal cursed city.

results.title: Cry Baby Cry
results.overview: Liz struggles to reclaim her sense of self and sexuality after a traumatic experience of sexual violation, navigating emotional isolation, friendship, and the complexities of modern dating in a quiet, introspective battle for healing.

results.title: Adegan Ciuman
results.overview: An amateur actor grows anxious about performing a kissing scene in his first short film. To ease his doubts, he invites his co-star to rehearse the moment together. Can they overcome the awkwardness?

results.title: History Makers: The Story of the 2010 AFC Women's Asian Cup Winners
results.original_title: History Makers: The Story of the 2010 AFC Women's Asian Cup Winners
results.overview: The Matildas made history by winning the AFC Women’s Asian Cup in 2010, becoming the first Australian senior national team to win an Asian Football Confederation title.  The landmark victory in Chengdu, China, in front of just 1,200 fans at Chengdu Sports Centre, was a watershed moment for women’s football in Australia. With an average age of 22, many of the team were participating in their first international tournament. Underdogs at the time, this team would go on to cultivate many of the household names fans celebrate today.

results.title: ReRooted

results.title: Off the Record
results.overview: Young singer-songwriter Astor Grey struggles to break free of a toxic relationship with a infamous bad-boy rock star who threatens to destroy her after promising her the world.

results.title: Open to Close: Inside the World's Top Restaurants
results.original_title: Open to Close: Inside the World's Top Restaurants
results.overview: From prep to service, Open to Close follows top chefs through a full day behind the pass—raw, real, and deep inside elite kitchens.

results.title: Beauty's Pride
results.overview: Beauty’s Pride is an evocative short film to accompany Born Ruffians’ new album by the same name.

results.title: The Day Iceland Stood Still
results.overview: When 90% of Iceland’s women walked off the job and out of their homes one morning in 1975, they brought their country to its knees and catapulted Iceland to the forefront of today's global fight for gender equality. Unexpectedly funny, laced with evocative animation and powerfully told by the women who lived it – this is the true story of 12 hours that launched a revolution.

results.title: Drainomania
results.overview: Unaware that her relationship is at a crossroads, lovable daydreamer Katie fails to complete a simple task at her girlfriend's request: to clean the bathroom. As a result, Katie finds herself swirling into a fever dream that could tear her apart or maybe bind them together forever.

results.title: No Friends
results.overview: A quirky comic portrait of the everyday loves, fears and triumphs of a group of New Yorkers in the immediate aftermath of the failed 1993 World Trade Center bombing, NO FRIENDS consists of the first two seasons of the sitcom "Friends" with the six main cast members (the "Friends") removed through editing. Shy immigrant Gunther is trying to get out more. Carol and Susan anxiously prepare for their wedding and first child. And is respectable dentist Dr Farber concealing a dark secret?

results.title: Balloon
results.overview: After a spy balloon crashes in rural Missouri, two local workers stumble upon something extraordinary at the wreckage site.

results.title: Tasting Room
results.overview: Five actors are forced to play deadly games centered around wine tasting.

results.title: Alien Contact: Government Coverup
results.overview: Explore the enduring mystery of the Roswell incident, where an alleged UFO crash in 1947 sparked decades of speculation and intrigue. Through eyewitness testimonies, expert analysis, and declassified documents, this documentary examines claims of extraterrestrial encounters and government coverups. Discover the cultural and historical impact of the event that ignited global fascination and ask: was it a weather balloon, or the greatest secret ever kept?

results.title: Pardesi
results.overview: After immigrating from India to Canada, Kirpa arrives with dreams of becoming a dancer. But as she faces discrimination and the harsh realities of survival in a new country, she must choose between holding onto her passion or sacrificing it to build a life.
